Agent Name: Orchestrator (thought)
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The orchestrator misinterpreted a regular 2018 video (“Human Origins 101”) as the “first National Geographic short on YouTube,” anchoring the entire investigation to the wrong target (#9) and initiating the loop. This step entered the loop on a false premise (Rule 1) by misreading the search results (Rule 2), making subsequent recovery difficult as later steps reinforced this incorrect assumption (Rule 3).
